children: Sweden defence firm's Q3 sales rose 30.6% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company secured major orders for Gripen, GlobalEye and German frigate systems
Saab says strong order backlog and programme progress position it for continued growth
Company sees growing customer demand reflected in recent major contract awards
MAJOR CONTRACT AWARDS - Co said Q3 results were driven by large orders for Gripen E, GlobalEye and German frigate systems
ORGANIC SALES GROWTH - Co reported 30.6% organic sales growth in Q3
HIGHER CASH FLOW - Co said operational cash flow increased sharply in Q3
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Saab AB is SEK630.00, about 0.8% below its October 22 closing price of SEK634.90
The stock recently traded at 34 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 31 three months ago
